understanding.intro: In the 30 years since, a series of breakthroughs led to the thinking machines we use every day.

nodes.name: Word embeddings
nodes.gist: Words became numbers a machine could compare, so similar meanings landed close together.

source.title: Efficient Estimation of Word Representations in Vector Space

nodes.name: The Transformer
nodes.gist: Attention let a model weigh every word against every other, and it scaled to huge amounts of text.

nodes.name: Few-shot prompting
nodes.gist: A large model could take on a new task from instructions written in plain language.

nodes.name: Instruction tuning
nodes.gist: Models learned to follow instructions and answer questions, so anyone could simply ask.

source.title: Training language models to follow instructions with human feedback
